query:
SELECT u.id AS "id!", u.name, u.email AS "email!"
            FROM "User" u
            WHERE u.id = $1
               OR u.id IN (
                    SELECT teammate.user_id
                    FROM team_user mine
                    JOIN team_user teammate ON teammate.team_id = mine.team_id
                    WHERE mine.user_id = $1
               )
            ORDER BY u.email
            LIMIT $2
